//: Declaration-only emit for design-sync. The app itself is noEmit, so there is no .d.ts tree for the converter's prop extractor to read and every <Name>Props came out as `[key: string]: unknown`. Emitting real declarations into frontend/types/ gives the extractor the true prop types. findTypesRoot() discovers `types/` by convention, so package.json needs no `types` field — and because exportedNames() only reads <pkg>/index.d.ts (which does not exist), the component list still comes solely from cfg.componentSrcMap rather than ballooning to every export.
